trigger.method: score-description.py: the skill is installed as a real .claude/skills/<name>/ and each query runs as a nested `claude -p`; a query counts as TRIGGERED when the Skill tool fires for it anywhere in the turn.

results.query: does this authoring guide skill actually help the agent, or is it decorative?
diagnose where meta:new-skill falls short and propose fixes
audit this review-lens skill — measure its real effect on the output
the guide skill doesn't seem to change what the agent produces, prove it either way
improve this guide skill without dropping what already worked
run a with-and-without comparison on this house-convention skill
scaffold a brand-new skill for writing changelogs
refresh the metadata.yaml for this skill after I edited its body
does this skill's description trigger on the right queries?
write me a react component for a date picker

checklist.note: Pure prose instructions to the operating agent about running a measurement pipeline; no embedded directive attempts to override the reading agent's own instructions.
No network calls or send-data-elsewhere logic; only local scratch-dir file writes described.
No keys/tokens/credentials present in SKILL.md or method.md.
No scripts/ directory and no shell commands anywhere in the material; nothing executes.
All content is readable Markdown prose; no base64/hex blobs or eval-of-decoded logic.
References an arXiv paper by id (2606.10546) only as citation text; no fetch/download-and-run behavior.
No file/credential-store reads described; skill only reads its own evals/rubric.json within the target skill under test.
No sudo/cron/profile-editing content; nothing executes at all.
